Draft 1 of 6 · file bugs/read-only-agent-runs-transition.md

Blueprint | An agent with read-only access to a ticket can still run a transition they own and move the ticket


Summary A ticket that an agent may only read (banner "You can read this ticket but not change it") still offers that agent the blueprint transition they own, and Run moves the ticket.
Steps to Reproduce
  • Create a blueprint where transition "QA onlyA" (Open → Escalated) is owned only by agent A.
  • Create a ticket in it owned by someone else, so agent A can only read it.
  • Sign in as agent A and open the ticket.
  • Click QA onlyA › Run.

    • Expected Result
  • Agent A sees the ticket read-only with no transition button (or a disabled one); a run through the API is refused.

    • Actual Result
  • The banner says "You can read this ticket but not change it" and Status is locked, but QA onlyA and Run are offered.
  • Run answers 200: #4182 moved Open → Escalated and History shows the agent did it (same on #4174).
  • Afterwards the agent gets "This ticket is not available" + "Permission denied."

    • Environment staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging), Microsoft Edge (headless) on Windows 10, 16 Nov 2026, owner account ndc-staging-owner and QA agent "Customer Experience Specialists 2" (Desk Agent, Customer Support).
    Suggested priority: High
    Related: NDC-3036, NDC-3056
    Evidence: screenshots/annotated/BUG-read-only-agent-runs-transition-FAIL.png (spec scripts/specs-bugs/BUG-read-only-agent-runs-transition.json)

    Draft 2 of 6 · file bugs/history-auto-step-wrong-from-to.md

    Ticket History | Automatic blueprint steps show the wrong From state and To state


    Summary When a blueprint step runs by itself (continuous blueprint or timer), its History line shows From state Open and To state Escalated, whatever the real move was. The status line next to it shows the real move.
    Steps to Reproduce
  • Create a continuous blueprint: Open → Escalated ("first", one checklist item) → On Hold ("auto", nothing to fill) → Closed ("end", nothing to fill).
  • Create a matching ticket and run "first".
  • Wait a few seconds; the ticket moves to On Hold and Closed by itself.
  • Open the ticket › History.

    • Expected Result
  • "Moved by <blueprint> automatically · Transition QA auto" shows From state Escalated, To state On Hold; QA end shows On Hold → Closed.

    • Actual Result
  • QA auto and QA end both show From state Open, To state Escalated (tickets #4165, #4166).
  • The Status changed lines next to them are correct (Escalated → On Hold, On Hold → Closed).
  • GET /desk/tickets/{id}/history: the ticket.blueprint_transition rows carry only the transition name, no from/to state.

    • Environment staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging), Microsoft Edge (headless) on Windows 10, 16 Nov 2026, owner account ndc-staging-owner.
    Suggested priority: Medium
    Related: NDC-3034 (From/To added to transition lines), NDC-3031 (continuous blueprints)
    Evidence: screenshots/annotated/BUG-history-auto-step-wrong-from-to-FAIL.png (spec scripts/specs-bugs/BUG-history-auto-step-wrong-from-to.json)

    Draft 3 of 6 · file bugs/audit-log-internal-ip.md

    Audit Log | Changes made in the web app show the server's internal address ::ffff:172.19.0.19 instead of the user's IP


    Summary Every change line in the Desk Audit Log (added, updated, published, deleted) shows IP ::ffff:172.19.0.19/128, an internal server address, for every user. Sign-in lines show the user's real public IP.
    Steps to Reproduce
  • Sign in to Desk and change anything (edit a blueprint description, add a skill, edit a ticket field).
  • Open Setup › Audit Log.
  • Compare the IP under your change with the IP under your sign-in line.

    • Expected Result
  • Each change line shows the IP of the user who made the change, the same as their sign-in line.

    • Actual Result
  • Change lines show "IP ::ffff:172.19.0.19/128" for every user and every entity.
  • GET /api/v1/audit/events: login/logout rows have the public IP (41.40.x.x, 41.44.x.x); desk created/updated rows have ::ffff:172.19.0.19/128 (48 of today's rows) or no IP.

    • Environment staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging), Microsoft Edge (headless) on Windows 10, 16 Nov 2026, owner account ndc-staging-owner.
    Suggested priority: Medium
    Related: NDC-3029 (blueprint audit entries), NDC-3027
    Evidence: screenshots/annotated/BUG-audit-log-internal-ip-FAIL.png (spec scripts/specs-bugs/BUG-audit-log-internal-ip.json)

    Draft 4 of 6 · file bugs/history-raw-closed-time.md

    Ticket History | Closed Time shows a raw timestamp and Resolution Time shows a bare number


    Summary After a ticket is closed, History shows "Closed Time was updated" with a raw ISO value in UTC and "Resolution Time was updated" with a bare number and no unit.
    Steps to Reproduce
  • Close a ticket (here: through a blueprint transition into Closed).
  • Open the ticket › History.

    • Expected Result
  • Closed Time in the user's date/time format and time zone (e.g. 16/11/2026 11:48 AM); Resolution Time with a unit (e.g. 11 minutes).

    • Actual Result
  • "Closed Time · New 2026-11-16T09:48:59.7799208+00:00" (#4177) and "2026-11-16T09:09:14.975698+00:00" (#4166).
  • "Resolution Time · New 11" / "New 3" with no unit, while Key Information shows "Less than a minute".

    • Environment staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging), Microsoft Edge (headless) on Windows 10, 16 Nov 2026, owner account ndc-staging-owner.
    Suggested priority: Low
    Related: NDC-3054 (close side effects)
    Evidence: screenshots/annotated/BUG-history-raw-closed-time-FAIL.png (spec scripts/specs-bugs/BUG-history-raw-closed-time.json)

    Draft 5 of 6 · file bugs/blueprint-api-guid-parser-text.md

    Blueprint API | A malformed transition owner id returns .NET parser text instead of a readable error


    Summary Saving a blueprint whose transition owner id is not a valid id returns 422 with internal framework text instead of a readable message naming the transition.
    Steps to Reproduce
  • Send POST /api/v1/modules/{tickets}/blueprints with a transition whose before.allowedUserIds = ["not-a-uuid"].
  • Read the error.

    • Expected Result
  • 422 with a plain message naming the transition and the bad value (e.g. "Transition QA x: 'not-a-uuid' is not a valid user id"), like the message for an unknown id.

    • Actual Result
  • 422 BLUEPRINT_DEFINITION_FIELD_INVALID on path "definition" with "The JSON value could not be converted to System.Guid. Path: $.transitions[0].before.allowedUserIds[0] | LineNumber: 0 | BytePositionInLine: 535."
  • A valid but unknown id gives the readable "No user exists with id …" (fixed under NDC-3037).

    • Environment staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging), Microsoft Edge (headless) on Windows 10, 16 Nov 2026, owner account ndc-staging-owner.
    Suggested priority: Low
    Related: NDC-3037
    Evidence: screenshots/annotated/BUG-blueprint-api-guid-parser-text-FAIL.png (spec scripts/specs-bugs/BUG-blueprint-api-guid-parser-text.json)

    Draft 6 of 6 · file bugs/blueprint-save-without-revision-overwrites.md

    Blueprint API | A save that sends no revision is accepted and silently overwrites a newer change


    Summary The NDC-3030 fix refuses a stale save that sends an old revision, but a save that sends no revision at all is still accepted and replaces the newer version. The designer always sends a revision; scripts or integrations that omit it can still lose other people's changes.
    Steps to Reproduce
  • GET a blueprint (revision 11).
  • Save a rename with revision 11 (200, revision 12).
  • From the copy read in step 1, save a description change through PUT /blueprints/{id} (and PUT …/draft) without a revision field.
  • GET the blueprint.

    • Expected Result
  • The save without a revision is refused (409, or 422 "revision is required"); the rename stays.

    • Actual Result
  • Both saves answer 200.
  • The name is back to the old one; the rename is lost with no warning. The same call with revision 11 gets 409 BLUEPRINT_REVISION_CONFLICT.

    • Environment staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging), Microsoft Edge (headless) on Windows 10, 16 Nov 2026, owner account ndc-staging-owner.
    Suggested priority: Low
    Related: NDC-3030 (designer path fixed)
    Evidence: screenshots/annotated/BUG-blueprint-save-without-revision-overwrites-FAIL.png (spec scripts/specs-bugs/BUG-blueprint-save-without-revision-overwrites.json)
